name: Emerald High School
bell_schedule:
Monday (all periods):
  Period 0:  7:15 AM – 8:20 AM
  Period 1:  8:30 AM – 9:20 AM
  Period 2:  9:28 AM – 10:18 AM
  Period 3:  10:26 AM – 11:16 AM
  Period 4:  11:24 AM – 12:14 PM
  Lunch:     12:14 PM – 12:49 PM
  ACCESS Period: 12:57 PM – 1:29 PM
  Period 5:  1:37 PM – 2:27 PM
  Period 6:  2:35 PM – 3:25 PM
  Period 7:  3:33 PM – 4:38 PM

Tuesday and Friday (all periods):
  Period 0:  7:15 AM – 8:20 AM
  Period 1:  8:30 AM – 9:26 AM
  Period 2:  9:34 AM – 10:30 AM
  Period 3:  10:38 AM – 11:38 AM
  Period 4:  11:46 AM – 12:42 PM
  Lunch:     12:42 PM – 1:17 PM
  Period 5:  1:25 PM – 2:21 PM
  Period 6:  2:29 PM – 3:25 PM
  Period 7:  3:33 PM – 4:38 PM

Wednesday (ODD periods only — 1, 3, 5):
  Staff Collaboration: 8:00 AM – 8:55 AM
  Period 1:  9:00 AM – 10:28 AM
  Period 3:  10:36 AM – 12:04 PM
  Lunch:     12:04 PM – 12:39 PM
  ACCESS Period: 12:47 PM – 1:49 PM
  Period 5:  1:57 PM – 3:25 PM

Thursday (EVEN periods only — 0, 2, 4, 6, 7):
  Period 0:  7:15 AM – 8:20 AM
  Period 2:  8:30 AM – 9:58 AM
  Period 4:  10:06 AM – 11:34 AM
  Lunch:     11:34 AM – 12:09 PM
  ACCESS Period: 12:17 PM – 1:09 PM
  Period 6:  1:17 PM – 2:45 PM
  Period 7:  2:53 PM – 3:58 PM

Minimum Days:
  Period 0:  7:15 AM – 8:20 AM
  Period 1:  8:30 AM – 9:00 AM
  Period 2:  9:07 AM – 9:37 AM
  Period 3:  9:44 AM – 10:14 AM
  Period 4:  10:21 AM – 10:51 AM
  Brunch:    10:51 AM – 11:06 AM
  Period 5:  11:13 AM – 11:43 AM
  Period 6:  11:50 AM – 12:20 PM
  Period 7:  12:27 PM – 12:57 PM

Wednesday and Thursday are block days: Wednesday meets odd periods only and
Thursday meets even periods only, so a given class does not meet every day.
